warnings: Steel mono-pitch roof (หลังคาเมทัลชีท): high side on grid 1 (+6.28), low side on grid 2 (อะเส top +5.85, A-06). Members from the sheet's ***หมายเหตุ*** legend: thin = Square Tube purlins @1.50, solid = จันทัน C-100x50x20x1.6, dash-dot heavy = อะเส 2C-150x50x20x2.3, thin long dash-dot = TRUSS T1 (grid 1), heavy long dash-short dash = TRUSS T2 (rows A and B).

T2 trusses (rows A, B) span from T1 on grid 1 to the อะเส on grid 2; their top chord overhangs both supports to the roof edge (truss elevation) — overhangs recorded as their own T2 segments, 1.00 from the roof-plan chain, top chord only.

The T1 and อะเส lines are drawn on through to the roof edges (A' / B'). The TRUSS T1 elevation itself shows no overhang (it ends at the two T2s) — the member's own detail wins, so no T1 overhang segment is recorded. The อะเส overhang segments are recorded from the plan alone at lower confidence (the A-06 section shows the อะเส only in cut).

Rafters and purlins carry no mark: element_id null with element_name_assigned (section 0.2). Columns C1 continue to the roof (truss elevations draw column stubs under every support) but no C1 mark is printed on this sheet, so none are recorded here.
